Built by the team behind DEUNAâthe fastest-growing Commerce OS in Latin AmericaâATHIA combines payment intelligence, checkout optimization, and data orchestration in one powerful solution. With deep integrations across 300+ PSPs and alternative payment methods, and over 20% of Mexicoâs digital economy running through our platform, we simplify global payments through a single integration and centralized reconciliation. We are a rapidly growing startup expanding into the U.S. to meet the urgent needs of large retailers, marketplaces, airlines, and QSRs. Join us to shape the future of payments! ð Visit https://www.deuna.com/ to learn more about us! About the Role As a Technical Account Manager (TAM), you will be the primary technical point of contact for our merchants after their initial go-live. You will help monitor merchant technical health, support incident management, answer ongoing technical questions, and guide merchants through future technical evolutions. For DEUNAâs premium and key accounts, the TAM plays a critical role in making sure merchants feel technically protected, proactively monitored, and confident operating on our platform. Your mission is to help ensure every merchant is operationally stable, technically satisfied, and continuously improving on DEUNA. Responsibilities Proactively monitor merchant technical health Monitor merchant performance, transaction behavior, errors, declines, latency, and anomalies. Identify potential risks before they become merchant-impacting issues. Raise internal flags when technical or operational risks are detected. Help maintain account-specific dashboards, alerts, and health views for key merchants. Be the main technical contact after go-live Act as the primary technical point of contact for merchant questions and doubts after go-live. Help merchants understand technical flows, configurations, integrations, and platform behavior. Coordinate internally with Product, Engineering, Support, Operations, and Account Management when merchant needs require cross-functional support. Support technical incident management Triage merchant-reported and internally detected issues. Escalate issues to the appropriate on-call, Engineering, Product, or Operations teams. Track resolution and ensure timely internal and external follow-up. Help ensure communication with merchants is clear, factual, and timely. Support post-incident follow-up, including impact explanation, corrective actions, and prevention measures when required. Drive merchant technical improvements Identify opportunities to improve merchant performance, stability, acceptance rate, routing behavior, fraud flows, provider configuration, or processing cost. Partner with Account Management to support merchant expansion and long-term account growth. Help merchants adopt new payment methods, providers, features, or technical capabilities after launch. Build merchant health visibility Build and deliver simple Merchant Health Reports periodically to Account Management and/or merchants. Maintain accurate technical documentation for merchant-specific configurations, customizations, providers, integrations, and known risks. Help prioritize and advocate for merchantsâ technical needs internally. Requirements 3+ years in Technical Account Management, Merchant Support, Solutions Engineering, Technical Customer Success, or similar roles. Strong technical understanding of online payment ecosystems, including APIs, SDKs, transaction flows, processors, acquirers, fraud tools, chargebacks, refunds, captures, and 3DS. Experience with incident management, post-launch technical operations, technical troubleshooting, and client-facing support. Ability to analyze logs, dashboards, error patterns, transaction behavior, and operational metrics. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to simplify technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders. Strong organization, ownership, urgency, and follow-up discipline. Fluent in Spanish and English. Experience working with LatAm merchants is a must. Startup environment experience is a plus. What Success Looks Like A successful TAM helps premium merchants feel that DEUNA is actively watching over their payment operation, not simply reacting when something breaks. The TAM should help ensure that: Merchant issues are detected and escalated quickly. Critical incidents are followed through with urgency and ownership. Merchants receive clear and timely technical communication. Account Management has strong technical support to retain and expand key accounts. Merchants continuously improve their technical performance and payment outcomes on DEUNA. \n \n What will you find when you join DEUNA? - A multicultural team distributed throughout LATAM - Dynamism, agility and constant innovation - Being part of a high-impact solution for an entire region - The best tools and technology to operate - Being part of the startup culture. - We are in full expansion! Wir können vieles richtig gut, aber eben noch nicht alles. Darum suchen wir immer wieder neue Kolleg:innen, die mit ihren Ideen, ihrem Können und Engagement etwas bewegen wollen. Fühlst du dich ange
items.description: Als IT-Dienstleister treiben wir die Digitalisierung des öffentlichen Sektors voran und schaffen echten Mehrwert für Millionen Menschen in Deutschland. Wir können vieles richtig gut, aber eben noch nicht alles. Darum suchen wir immer wieder neue Kolleg:innen, die mit ihren Ideen, ihrem Können und Engagement etwas bewegen wollen. Fühlst du dich angesprochen? Dann gestalte Deine Welt zum Besseren und werde Teil unseres Customer Clusters Finance. DEINE MISSION Als Senior Oracle Data Engineer (m/w/d) übernimmst du fachliche Verantwortung für anspruchsvolle Datenbanklösungen und gestaltest performante, sichere Anwendungen auf Basis von Oracle-Technologien. Du bringst deine Expertise in SQL, PL/SQL und Oracle Data Integrator ein, koordinierst das Entwicklerteam und sorgst mit sicherem Auftreten dafür, dass Projektleitung und Endkunde jederzeit bestens abgeholt sind. Deine Aufgaben: Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung von Datenbanklösungen auf Basis von Oracle sowie SQL und PL/SQL Erfahrung in der Konzeption und Umsetzung von Integrationsprozessen mit Oracle Data Integrator (ODI) sind wünschenswert Übernahme fachlicher Verantwortung für Themen und Anforderungen im Projektkontext Aktive Unterstützung und Koordination des Entwicklerteams Zügige Einarbeitung in neue Technologien und Themenstellungen Nutzung von Jira und Confluence zur Planung, Dokumentation und Nachverfolgung der Entwicklungsarbeiten Sicherer Umgang mit Git und gängigen Entwicklungswerkzeugen wie Visual Studio Code Moderation, Kommunikation und adressatengerechte Vermittlung technischer Inhalte Sicheres Auftreten in Abstimmungen mit der Projektleitung und dem Endkunden DAS IST UNS WICHTIG Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Oracle-Datenbanken sowie SQL und PL/SQL Grundkenntnisse in Oracle Data Integrator (ODI) Erfahrung mit Jira und Confluence Sicherer Umgang mit Git und gängigen Entwicklungswerkzeugen, beispielsweise Visual Studio Code Fähigkeit zur Übernahme fachlicher Verantwortung Gute Moderations-, Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten Fähigkeit, technische Inhalte adressatengerecht zu vermitteln Sicheres Auftreten in Abstimmungen mit der Projektleitung und dem Endkunden Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (C1-Niveau) sowie gute Englischkenntnisse Nice to have: Data-Vault-Datenmodellierung Containerisierung mit Podman Oracle Analytics Server Oracle APEX DEIN NEUER ARBEITSPLATZ Was bei uns zählt? Klar definierte Rollen, echtes Miteinander und ein gemeinsames Ziel. Wir nennen das Responsiveness – transparent, wertschätzend und zielorientiert. Hier bist du am Wandel direkt beteiligt, wenn du möchtest. – Nimm Teil an Projekten, die uns als Unternehmen weiterentwickeln. Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Remote Work? – Sind selbstverständlich. Individuelles Hardware-Budget? – Stell dir deinen Arbeitsplatz so zusammen, wie du dich am wohlsten fühlst. Mental Health? – Dein mentales Wohlbefinden ist uns wichtig. Mit OpenUp unterstützen wir dich und bieten dir jederzeit kostenlosen Zugang zu professioneller psychologischer Unterstützung. Individuelles Weiterbildungsbudget? – Egal ob die nächste Zertifizierung oder ein lang ersehnter Sprachkurs – du entscheidest, worin und wann du dich weiterbildest. Mitarbeiter:innen-PC-Programm? – Lease dir dein nächstes Device zur rein privaten Nutzung einfach über virtual7. JobRad oder Firmenwagen? – Wir helfen dir dabei, so mobil zu sein, wie du es brauchst. Erzähl mir, wer du bist und wann du anfangen kannst. Gerne auch über Laura Korth Senior Recruiting Specialist +49 170 3600221 Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

items.summary: About the Role Join Uber's pioneering Families Safety team and help shape the future of safe mobility for all family members-whether they're teens, caregivers, or older adults. As the Growth Bets Program Manager for Families Safety, you'll lead safety operations for Uber's Families portfolio, from Uber Teens to Older Adults. You'll work cross-funct
items.description: Data and Analytics About the Role Join Uber's pioneering Families Safety team and help shape the future of safe mobility for all family members-whether they're teens, caregivers, or older adults. As the Growth Bets Program Manager for Families Safety, you'll lead safety operations for Uber's Families portfolio, from Uber Teens to Older Adults. You'll work cross-functionally to design and implement safety frameworks, risk mitigation strategies, and scalable solutions that protect and empower families while enabling rapid business growth. What the Candidate Will Do Develop & Execute Safety Strategy : Define a comprehensive safety framework for the Families portfolio, ensuring seamless integration of best practices. Mitigate Risk Across Key Products : Assess safety risks for Uber Teens, Older Adults, and Caregiver products, implementing proactive mitigation measures. Embed Safety into Business Growth : Partner with product, engineering, and operations teams to balance risk management with innovation and rapid expansion. Optimize & Scale Safety Programs : Monitor key performance indicators, refine mitigation strategies, and ensure consistency across global and regional safety initiatives. Drive Cross-Functional Alignment : Collaborate with internal stakeholders (Eng, Ops, Product, legal) to codify safety mitigations and maintain high safety standards as these programs scale. Operate as a Self-Starter : Work autonomously and thrive in an environment where you may not be co-located with your manager, proactively engaging collaborators and driving projects to completion. What the Candidate Will Need English proficiency Google Sheets proficiency 6+ years of experience in Program Management : Experience leading complex, cross-functional programs, ideally in safety, risk, or operations. Independent Execution : Proven ability to drive initiatives without direct oversight, solving problems proactively. Cross-Functional Collaboration : Strong track record of working with product, engineering, legal, and operations teams. Innovation & Adaptability : Comfort navigating evolving risk landscapes and regulatory environments, implementing mitigation strategies and scaling safety solutions. Data-Driven Approach : Ability to analyze key metrics and use insights to improve safety and operational processes. Stakeholder Management : Strong written and verbal communication skills, with experience influencing stakeholders and driving alignment Decision Making : Navigating High-Stakes Decisions, balancing stakeholder input, making difficult decisions, and maintain trust in high-impact situations Risk Assessment & Mitigation : Demonstrated ability to identify, evaluate, and address risks in dynamic, fast-growing environments. Preferred Qualifications Industry Experience: Background in mobility, transportation, or safety-related technology is a plus. Hands-on experience with SQL-based data extraction and transformation Ability to create insightful visualizations in Tableau for data storytelling and analytics We welcome people from all backgrounds who seek the opportunity to help build a future where everyone and everything can move independently. If you have the curiosity, passion, and collaborative spirit, work with us, and let's move the world forward, together. Offices continue to be central to collaboration and Uber's cultural identity. Unless formally approved to work fully remotely, Uber expects employees to spend at least half of their work time in their assigned office. For certain roles, such as those based at green-light hubs, employees are expected to be in-office for 100% of their time. Please speak with your recruiter to better understand in-office expectations for this role. *Accommodations may be available based on religious and/or medical conditions, or as required by applicable law. To request an accommodation, please reach out to accommodations@uber.com.

items.title: Principal Technical Program Manager, Industry Software
items.summary: About the team The Industry Software organization builds the B2B SaaS platforms that power Zillow's software and services for real estate professionals, including: - Home listing, lead delivery, and home shopper lifecycle workflows - Identity and access: account hierarchies, user identity, team roster/permissions management - Enterprise integration
items.description: Software Engineering About the team The Industry Software organization builds the B2B SaaS platforms that power Zillow's software and services for real estate professionals, including: - Home listing, lead delivery, and home shopper lifecycle workflows - Identity and access: account hierarchies, user identity, team roster/permissions management - Enterprise integrations: broker rosters, listing feeds, partner data pipelines - Monetization: purchasing, pricing, billing, entitlements, and internal tooling for sales, support, and operations We work in tight partnership with Product, Engineering, Design, Data, Marketing, Sales, Customer Support, and Finance to build an integrated, reliable, and scalable B2B ecosystem for our industry customers - and we aim to do it smart, humble, hardworking, and highly collaborative. About the role We're seeking a Principal Technical Program Manager to own some of the most complex, strategically important initiatives in Industry Software - multi-team, cross-organizational programs that span multiple product areas, from strategy and scope through execution, launch, and post-launch learning. You'll act as a thought partner to senior and executive leaders, bridge Product, Engineering, and Design to create clarity from ambiguity, and build deep expertise across our domains (monetization, identity and access, enterprise integrations, real estate SaaS and lead delivery) while operating as a strong generalist who ramps up quickly elsewhere. You'll operate at both strategic and tactical levels: energized by building structure where little exists, balancing technical depth with strong stakeholder management, and setting direction while rolling up your sleeves to get high-quality work done on time. What You'll Do Strategy and planning : Define cross-org initiatives that align with Industry Software and broader Zillow B2B priorities; translate strategy into program charters, success metrics, and multi-release execution plans; shape scope and sequencing with Product, Engineering, and Design leaders. Execution and delivery : Own the program lifecycle end to end - planning, dependency mapping, execution, launch, and post-launch follow-through - and drive the operating rhythms (status reviews, dependency checkpoints, release readiness) that keep teams delivering reliably, without subsuming team-level agile ceremonies owned by EMs and PMs. Risk and metrics : Identify risks, dependencies, and bottlenecks early; drive mitigation and tradeoff decisions with leadership; use data to measure program health and guide iterative improvement. Stakeholder communication : Orchestrate cross-functional collaboration across Engineering, Product, Design, Data, Sales, Marketing, Customer Support, Finance, Legal, and Operations; communicate status, risks, and decisions in a crisp, executive-ready narrative up to VP/SVP level. Technical leadership : Build working knowledge of the systems, APIs, and data flows within your program scope; partner with Principal Engineers and architects to shape technical approach; ramp up quickly across domains like monetization, identity and access, enterprise integrations, and real estate SaaS/lead delivery. TPM craft : Define and refine planning, risk, and reporting best practices for Industry Software; mentor other TPMs as a force multiplier for program management excellence; use AI-native tools to increase program efficiency and decision speed. This role has been categorized as a Remote position. "Remote" employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions. In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $182,100.00 - $290,900.00 annually. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Virginia the standard base pay range for this role is $173,000.00 - $276,400.00 annually. The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations. In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside. Who you are 8+ years in Technical Program Management (or equivalent), leading large-scale, multi-team, cross-org programs - including portfolio-level and multi-quarter planning - at mid-size or large companies. Significant experience with B2B SaaS products or platforms , ideally serving business customers with complex account, identity, integration, or monetization needs. Proven track record owning end-to-end delivery of complex, distributed systems or platforms, with strong technical fluency in modern architectures (microservices, event-driven patterns, data pipelines) and the ability to engage deeply with engineering teams. Demonstrated ability to build program structure from the ground up: operating rhythms, governance, and metrics for complex initiatives. Exceptional written and verbal communication, including executive-ready narratives, and proven ability to influence without authority across Product, Engineering, Design, and other partners up to senior and executive leadership. Comfortable applying data-driven prioritization to trade off scope, quality, cost, and schedule across multiple simultaneous programs in a fast-moving environment. Preferred Qualifications Deep experience in one or more Industry Software domains - identity and access, monetization and billing, enterprise integrations, or real estate SaaS and lead delivery - or in adjacent complex B2B platforms (ecommerce, fintech, ad tech), ideally within a platform or internal tools organization where reliability and partner integration are critical. Demonstrated experience mentoring TPMs or shaping TPM best practices within an organization. Familiarity with AI and modern collaboration tooling (program dashboards, automation, document generation) to streamline program management. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. If this sounds like you, we'd love to have you help lead the next chapter of Industry Software at Zillow. Get to know us At Zillow, we're reimagining how people move-through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you'll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality. How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they're most productive-enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise. Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME's America's Best Companies 2026 list , reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow. No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry-and your career-forward, together. Zillow Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact your recruiter directly. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable state and local law. Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company's reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

items.summary: The opportunity As a Siemens Polarion Architect (ALM) , you will be responsible for defining, designing, and guiding scalable Siemens Polarion ALM solutions that support requirements management, engineering traceability, baselines, change control, verification management, and compliance across HVDC projects. You will act as a key technical authorit
items.description: Software Engineering The opportunity As a Siemens Polarion Architect (ALM) , you will be responsible for defining, designing, and guiding scalable Siemens Polarion ALM solutions that support requirements management, engineering traceability, baselines, change control, verification management, and compliance across HVDC projects. You will act as a key technical authority for Polarion architecture, working closely with engineering, quality, IT, and business stakeholders to translate complex business needs into robust ALM capabilities, governance models, integrations, and long-term platform roadmaps. How You Will Make an Impact Own and define the Siemens Polarion ALM solution architecture to support requirements management, compliance, verification, traceability, and change control across HVDC projects. Design and govern Polarion information models, workflows, work item structures, document templates, baselines, approvals, permissions, and governance frameworks. Provide architectural leadership for Polarion configuration, customization, automation, dashboards, LiveReports, and extensions, ensuring scalability and maintainability. Establish best practices for requirements lifecycle management, end-to-end traceability, test management, defect handling, change impact analysis, and compliance reporting. Design and oversee integrations between Polarion and enterprise tools, including PLM, DevOps, engineering, and test management platforms, using REST APIs, SDKs, and OSLC standards. Drive decisions related to platform performance, scalability, security, access management, data quality, upgrades, and lifecycle governance. Collaborate with engineering, business, IT, and vendor stakeholders to align Polarion capabilities with organizational processes and ALM strategy. Lead solution reviews, continuous improvements, issue resolution, user enablement, and mentoring to promote sustainable Polarion best practices. Your Background Extensive experience with Siemens Polarion ALM in roles such as Solution Architect, Technical Lead, Senior Configurator, or similar positions within compliance-driven engineering environments. Proven ability to design and implement end-to-end ALM solutions covering requirements, testing, traceability, change management, approvals, reporting, and compliance. Strong knowledge of requirements lifecycle management, including authoring, reviews, baselining, change control, reuse, variants, and traceability. Hands-on experience configuring and customizing Polarion, including workflows, work item types, permissions, dashboards, LiveReports, automation, and reporting solutions. Solid technical skills in Java, JavaScript, Velocity, REST APIs, SDKs, OSLC concepts, and enterprise system integration approaches. Experience defining solution architecture, governance models, data structures, security concepts, release management, upgrade strategies, and configuration standards. Strong analytical and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to resolve complex technical challenges and translate business needs into scalable solutions. Excellent communication and documentation skills, with experience creating architecture documentation, technical guidance, training materials, and supporting user adoption; experience with tools such as Azure DevOps, Teamcenter, Jira, Git-based platforms, or related ALM/PLM ecosystems is an advantage. More about us Collective agreement Flexible working time Health care and wellness allowance Fantastic career possibilities within Hitachi Energy both within Sweden and globally Mentor to support you throughout onboard phase Various trainings and education supporting employee development Diversified company with over 70+ nationalities working in Sweden Supplementary compensation for parental leave Employee Benefit Portal with discounts and perks Are you ready for a new exciting challenge? Does the above description sound like you? Welcome to apply now! Applications will be reviewed after summer vacations, but don't delay - apply today! Recruiting manager: Devendra Singh devendra.s.singh@hitachienergy.com will answer your questions about the position. items.description: Management and Finance Headquarters: Canada URL: https://www.guesty.com Guesty is the all-in-one platform helping hospitality businesses around the world automate, optimize, and scale their operations. We’re a fast-growing global startup that’s transforming how the industry works — from guest experience to business growth. With a powerful suite of features and integrations with 150+ industry partners — including Airbnb, Vrbo, Booking.com , Expedia, Google Travel, and many more — Guesty empowers property managers to deliver top-tier guest experiences while running more efficient, data-driven operations. We’re proud to have over 900+ team members across 16 countries worldwide, all working together to build the future of hospitality technology. If you’re looking to grow your career in a dynamic, global, and impact-driven environment, we’d love to hear from you. We are looking for a Shield Program Lead to take end-to-end ownership of the operations and ongoing performance of Guesty Shield globally. You will lead the internal claims team, manage commercial relationships with insurers and program partners, and ensure customers receive a reliable experience from enrollment through claims resolution and payment. You will drive improvements in customer retention, operational efficiency and program profitability, while leading new product launches and improvements alongside Product and other internal teams. This is a hands-on role for someone with experience in the short-term rental/vacation rental industry who can manage people, lead commercial discussions and follow through on operational details. Responsibilities Program Operations Own the day-to-day operation of Shield across all active markets, with clear processes, accountability and consistent service delivery. Establish reporting, controls and escalation procedures, and resolve recurring operational issues. Drive automation and process improvements that enable the program to scale efficiently. Maintain visibility into program performance, risks and action plans. Team Leadership and Claims Oversight Manage and develop the internal claims team, including workload allocation, coaching, performance management and quality assurance. Oversee the claims journey from submission through decision and payment of approved claims, in coordination with insurers and claims partners. Establish and monitor service levels, ensuring timely customer communication and payment. Resolve overdue claims and complex escalations, holding partners accountable for agreed commitments. Ensure claims are handled accurately and consistently with applicable coverage terms. Customer Retention Own Shield retention performance and lead initiatives to reduce churn in partnership with Customer Success. Identify cancellation drivers and early signs of dissatisfaction, and translate findings into corrective actions. Address retention issues related to pricing, coverage, claims experience and service delivery. Distinguish Shield-specific cancellations from broader Guesty churn, and monitor reductions in coverage among existing customers. Commercial Partnerships and Program Economics Own ongoing relationships with insurers, claims administrators and other program partners. Lead commercial discussions, renewals, performance reviews and escalations, coordinating with Finance and Legal. Negotiate improvements to commercial terms, service levels and operating processes. Track program revenue, margins and operating costs with Finance, and identify opportunities to improve profitability while maintaining service and coverage quality. Manage partner transitions and ensure continuity of service. Requirements Must Prior experience in the short-term rental (STR) / vacation rental industry, with a strong understanding of property manager operations, guest-related damage and protection needs. 5+ years of relevant experience in program management, insurance or protection programs, operations, or a closely related field. Proven experience directly managing and developing an operational team. Experience managing insurers or insurance partners, including commercial negotiations and service performance. Strong understanding of claims workflows, customer service and operational controls. Commercial and analytical judgment, with the ability to use data to improve retention, profitability and service quality. A track record of leading cross-functional initiatives from planning through implementation. Strong communication, negotiation and problem-solving skills. Ability to work across markets and time zones and take ownership in a fast-moving environment. Preferred Qualifications Experience in embedded insurance or property protection programs. Experience managing international programs and partner relationships. Experience implementing workflow automation, operational dashboards or claims management systems. **Please note that this is a Remote position** __________________________________________ Compensation range: 120-140K OTE annually *Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location.* - Guesty is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants regardless of race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by law. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/guesty-shield-program-lead

items.description: Product Headquarters: Remote Storyblok is a headless CMS that enables marketers and developers to create with joy and publish with confidence. It empowers you to deliver structured and consistent content everywhere: websites, apps, AI search, and beyond. Legendary brands like Virgin Media O2, Oatly, and TomTom use Storyblok to make a bigger, faster market impact. WHAT IS IN IT FOR YOU You will be joining a growing company where you can contribute to many “firsts”. Plus these benefits: Monthly remote work stipend (home internet costs, electricity). Home office equipment package right at the start (laptop, keyboard, monitor…) Home office equipment upgrade (furniture, ear plugs …) or membership to a local co-working space after your onboarding Sick leave benefit, parental leave and 25 days of annual leave plus your local national holidays Personal development fund for courses, books, conferences, and material The annual international team-building trip, quarterly and monthly online get-togethers As a fully remote company, with work-life balance at its core, you’ll enjoy flexible schedules An international team that loves to have fun at work and works hard together to accomplish shared goals JOB SUMMARY You will own the reliability, performance, and cost efficiency of the PostgreSQL data platform behind our flagship CMS — primarily Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL — along with the infrastructure and automation around it. This is a reliability engineering role, not a classic administration one. Aurora takes care of patching, backups, failover, and storage growth; you own what it does not — query and index strategy, plan regressions across major version upgrades, vacuum and bloat, connection management, zero-downtime schema change, logical replication, and capacity and cost modeling. Alongside this, you work as a full member of the Infrastructure team on Terraform, CI/CD, observability, and security tooling, and you share the on-call rotation. You will work in a shared-ownership model: backend teams own their queries and schemas, and you own the platform, guardrails, tooling, and knowledge-sharing that make their decisions safe. You will collaborate closely with backend engineers, DevOps engineers, Security, product owners, and the Data team. We measure success by the reliability and predictable performance of the data platform, the quality of your incident response, and how well other engineering teams are equipped to make sound database decisions without you in the room. ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS Database platform (approx. 60%) Own the reliability, performance, and scalability of our PostgreSQL platform (primarily Amazon Aurora): query and index strategy, execution plans, configuration tuning, and capacity planning, with particular attention to hot multi-tenant read paths. Lead zero-downtime version upgrades and schema migrations at scale, including diagnosing and preventing plan regressions across Aurora major versions. Own the operational health of the platform: vacuum strategy and bloat, long-running transactions and wraparound risk, connection management and pooling (including RDS Proxy), lock contention, and logical replication and slot hygiene. Review schema changes and DDL from backend teams for lock behavior, migration safety, and performance impact, and build the guardrails and tooling that make safe changes to the default path. Own backup, restore, and disaster recovery end-to-end, including rehearsed restore drills and the access, encryption, and auditing controls our compliance obligations require. Model database capacity and cost (I/O-Optimized vs. Standard, Serverless v2 sizing, read replica strategy) and drive cost-efficiency without compromising reliability. Infrastructure and automation (approx. 40%) Deliver infrastructure and automation as a full member of the Infrastructure team, using Terraform and cloud-native tooling on AWS, and contribute to CI/CD pipelines including the safe automated handling of database changes. Build and maintain monitoring, alerting, and observability for database and platform systems (e.g. pg_stat_statements, Prometheus exporters, Grafana, Datadog, OpenTelemetry) so problems surface before customers feel them. Use cloud security and vulnerability management tooling (such as Aikido) to triage findings and keep the team's services compliant. Team, incidents, and collaboration Take part in the on-call rotation, incident response, and postmortems, driving root cause analysis and remediation that prevents recurrence. Raise the database competence of the wider engineering organization through design reviews, documentation and runbooks, and mentoring — so this expertise is not concentrated in one person. Demonstrate AI literacy, leveraging AI tools to enhance productivity, decision-making, and quality of work while applying sound judgment and critical thinking. EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE; QUALIFICATIONS Required — PostgreSQL depth 7+ years in database engineering, database reliability, infrastructure, or SRE roles, including significant hands-on ownership of production PostgreSQL. Deep PostgreSQL expertise: internals and MVCC, reading and acting on EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS), indexing strategy, vacuum behavior, locking, connection pooling, and configuration tuning. Strong experience with Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL and AWS-managed database services. Proven track record of zero-downtime upgrades and complex schema migrations on large, busy tables. Hands-on experience with physical and logical replication, partitioning, read scaling, and designing and validating backup and disaster-recovery strategies. Required — Infrastructure and ways of working Solid experience with Infrastructure-as-Code, primarily Terraform, on AWS. Strong Linux fundamentals plus fluency in at least one scripting language (Bash, Python, Ruby, or Go) for automation and tooling. Experience with monitoring and observability tooling, and a solid grasp of security practices (IAM, secrets management, network segmentation). Experience with change, incident, and problem management in production, and with Git and modern CI/CD workflows applied to database changes. Strong written and verbal communication in a remote-first organization, including the ability to explain database trade-offs to backend engineers and non-specialists. Willingness and ability to participate in an on-call rotation. Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Nice to have Familiarity with backend frameworks that interact with PostgreSQL (Ruby on Rails preferred; Python, Rust, or Elixir valued). Experience with caching layers (Redis, Memcached) and their interaction with database load. Exposure to analytics pipelines and warehousing (Redshift, Snowflake, ClickHouse) or CDC-based data flows. Experience with container platforms (ECS, EKS, Fargate), NoSQL or vector databases, or AWS certification (Database – Specialty, DevOps Engineer – Professional). MENTAL, PHYSICAL AND ENVIRONMENTAL REQUIREMENTS Remote (home) work opportunity or funded by Storyblok co-working space GENERAL TERMS Storyblok has a commitment to diversity and inclusion. We strive to create a hiring environment in which all people feel they are equally respected and valued, irrespective of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, age, religion, citizenship or any other characteristic. You can find more information about our privacy policy here . All communications regarding job opportunities at Storyblok will come from an official Storyblok employee with an email address ending in @storyblok.com. We will never redirect you to another portal or another site that is unrelated to our domain ( storyblok.com ). Here is a sneak peek of Storyblok’s Visual Editor If you need an accommodation for any part of the application process, please email talent.acquisition@storyblok.com To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/storyblok-senior-database-reliability-engineer-i-germany-austria-uk

items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: URL: http://cmswa.com Custom Mechanical Solutions delivers energy-efficient HVAC systems across the Pacific Northwest, with deep expertise in healthcare, education, data centers, and retrofit projects. We work with top manufacturers to meet performance and sustainability goals—always focused on quality, care, and progress. If you're ready to grow your career, we’re glad you found us. At CMS, you’ll join a team that supports your development and gives you space to make an impact. We review every application carefully and appreciate your interest in growing your career with our team. About Custom Mechanical Solutions Custom Mechanical Solutions (CMS) provides commercial HVAC equipment and technical solutions for complex building applications. We partner with contractors, engineers, building owners, and manufacturers throughout the equipment lifecycle—from system design and delivery through startup, troubleshooting, and field support. As part of the Meriton family of companies, CMS maintains its specialized technical expertise and customer-focused approach while benefiting from the resources and long-term investment of a growing national organization. Title: Quality & Reliability Engineer Department: CMS National Accounts Location: Fully remote within the United States Travel: Approximately 10–20% domestic and international travel Turn field challenges into better products, stronger processes, and more reliable outcomes. Join a growing National Accounts team where your technical judgment, curiosity, and follow-through will connect the jobsite to the factory and help shape how quality is managed as the business scales. The opportunity CMS is looking for a Quality & Reliability Engineer to own and continuously improve the field-to-factory quality feedback loop for custom commercial and industrial HVAC equipment. You will lead technical investigations, turn incomplete field information into clear problem statements, and keep root-cause and corrective-action work moving through verified closure. This is a hands-on, highly collaborative role. You will work across field operations, project teams, customers, engineering, manufacturing, suppliers, and factory quality leaders. Your work will help teams respond faster, create repeatable repairs, reduce recurrence, and apply lessons learned to future projects. Work from where you are. This is a fully remote position that can be based anywhere within the United States. Approximately 10-20% domestic and international travel is expected, including travel to customer sites and manufacturing facilities in Mexico. Travel may be heavier initially while you build relationships with key stakeholders and learn the factory systems. Travel to Mexico is generally expected up to four times per year to support investigations, gather technical evidence, collaborate with factory teams, and validate corrective actions. What you will own Lead field-to-factory investigations. Coordinate quality issues from initial report through containment, root cause, corrective action, and verified closure. Turn field intelligence into action. Gather the technical evidence needed for faster decisions and translate recurring trends into improvements in design, manufacturing, supplier controls, installation guidance, training, and documentation. Create field-ready solutions. Develop clear, controlled Field Service Bulletins with approved repair steps, safety requirements, acceptance criteria, and closeout evidence. Drive clarity and accountability. Keep owners, milestones, risks, decisions, and overdue actions visible. Remove blockers and escalate high-impact or aging issues when needed. Use data to improve the program. Maintain quality dashboards and reports, identify systemic trends and emerging risks, and provide concise updates to leadership, project teams, customers, and factory partners. Go where the evidence is. Travel to customer sites and manufacturing facilities in Mexico to inspect equipment, support troubleshooting, gather evidence, collaborate with factory teams, and validate repair effectiveness. You will probably love this role if... When something fails, your first question is “Why?” and you keep digging until the evidence supports the answer. You enjoy both the technical details and the bigger picture, from walking a jobsite and troubleshooting equipment to explaining the path forward clearly. You take ownership without waiting for every step to be laid out, bring the right people together, and keep work moving until the issue is truly closed. You are comfortable influencing across teams, even when you do not directly manage the people involved. You want to help build and improve a quality program, not simply maintain one. Required qualifications A bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, Manufacturing, or Quality Engineering, or an equivalent combination of technical education and relevant professional experience. At least three years of relevant experience in manufacturing quality, field service, commissioning, reliability engineering, technical investigations, or related technical project support. Strong mechanical and/or electrical investigation and troubleshooting skills. Working knowledge of structured problem-solving methods such as RCA, CAPA, 8D, 5 Why, fishbone analysis, or FMEA. Ability to translate incomplete field information into clear technical problem statements and drive corrective actions through verified closure. Ability to communicate complex technical issues clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences. Ability to travel domestically and internationally approximately 10–20%, including travel to manufacturing facilities in Mexico. A valid passport at the time of hire is preferred; candidates without one must be able to obtain one within the first 90 days of employment. Preferred qualifications Five or more years of relevant quality, reliability, field-service, commissioning, or technical investigation experience. Direct experience with commercial or industrial HVAC equipment. Experience with custom air-handling equipment, controls, construction drawings and specifications, startup, commissioning, or active job-site processes. Experience working directly with manufacturing facilities, suppliers, factory quality teams, or field-service organizations. Experience developing technical repair procedures, Field Service Bulletins, corrective-action documentation, or quality dashboards. Compensation and benefits Base salary: $95,000-$125,000 annually, depending on experience. This position is also eligible for a discretionary bonus. Eligible employees may participate in Meriton’s benefits programs in accordance with applicable plan terms. Why CMS National Accounts You will join a fast-moving team supporting complex equipment and significant projects where expectations are high, and the connection between field performance and customer experience matters. This role offers the opportunity to make quality information more complete, corrective actions more durable, repairs more repeatable, and lessons learned more useful across a growing portfolio. If you are ready to solve meaningful technical problems and help build a stronger quality and reliability program, we would like to hear from you. Custom Mechanical Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer Employment practices will not be influenced or affected by an applicant’s or employee’s race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status or any other legally protected status. Reasonable accommodations will be made for qualified individuals with disabilities unless doing so would result in an undue hardship. Salary ranges listed are dependent upon a candidate’s qualifications, experience, internal equity, and the budgeted amount for the specific role and location. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/custom-mechanical-solutions-quality-and-reliability-engineer

You'll join the Tribe building for managers, the people who plan work, protect margins, and keep projects on time
items.description: Full-Stack Programming Headquarters: Tallinn, Estonia URL: https://toggl.com/jobs/ We are looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to join one of our Product Tribes, the cross-functional units that own the end-to-end experience for a specific Toggl user role. You'll join the Tribe building for managers, the people who plan work, protect margins, and keep projects on time and on budget. You own significant parts of that experience end-to-end, working hands-on with product and design to ship work that matters. You'll do this as we build and launch Toggl 2.0, our consolidated planning, time tracking, and time intelligence product. The salary for this position is €83,000 annually. You can work from anywhere in the world as long as your main location is between UTC-4 and UTC+4. The Role As a Senior Full Stack Engineer, you own meaningful parts of the product end-to-end, from the data model and the API to the interface someone actually clicks: the technical approach, the quality of what ships, and whether it actually works for the people using it. You are accountable not for tickets closed, but for clarity, craft, and outcomes. You'll work in the Tribe serving managers, across planning and capacity management, dashboards, and billable work. This is some of the most data-dense, interaction-heavy surface area in the product: schedules and capacity views, reports, and visualizations that have to stay fast and readable at real customer scale. The interesting problems live on both sides of the API here - the query behind a capacity view matters as much as how that view renders. You'll build with React and TypeScript on the frontend and our backend services (mostly Golang) and data layer (Postgres) behind them, alongside a product manager, a designer, and engineers who are used to owning their work and pushing back when something isn't right. In a tribe of 5 other engineers, your impact and visibility are high. Our team meetings are scheduled between 11:00 and 16:00 UTC. Your availability and commitment to participate in these sessions are essential for effective collaboration and team alignment. Your main responsibilities will be: Ownership and delivery Take projects from problem to production. Own the technical approach for major features front to back, break the work down sensibly, sequence it, and ship in slices rather than one big drop. Make the technical calls in your area. Choose between options, name the tradeoffs, and decide without waiting for permission or escalating routine judgment. Keep your work visible without being chased. Flag risks and slips early, keep the Tribe in the loop, and unblock yourself. Craft and quality across the stack Build interfaces people trust with dense, real-world data. Planning views, dashboards, and reports that stay fast, accessible, and readable when the dataset gets ugly. Design the data and API layer those views depend on. Model it so the feature you're building now doesn't make the next three harder. Own performance as a feature, end to end. Profile, measure, and fix the slow query and the slow render instead of hoping the data stays small. Write code others can work in. Sensible components and services, real test coverage where it earns its keep, and a codebase that's easier to change after you touch it. Working with product and design Shape solutions, don't just implement them. Push on the problem, question requirements that don't hold up, and propose simpler paths when you see one. Partner closely with design. Prototype early, spot the edge cases in a flow before it's built, and hold the bar on UX quality with your designer rather than after handoff. Stay close to users and evidence. Join user tests, read the feedback, look at the data, and let it change what you build. Raising the bar Review code with intent. Give precise, actionable feedback that makes the change and the person better. Mentor and interview. Help other engineers grow, and help us hire well. Improve things across team boundaries. Spot shared components and duplicated work between Tribes, and raise it before we build the same thing twice. AI as core leverage Use AI tools extensively in your daily work for exploration, prototyping, code generation and review, debugging, research, and writing. AI fluency is not optional. It's part of how you increase your speed, depth, and impact - and you're expected to help the rest of the Tribe get better at it too. About You You will thrive in this role if you: Have significant experience building and shipping production web applications end to end, and can lead major projects rather than just contribute to them. Are genuinely comfortable on both sides of the stack. You're deep on one side and properly capable on the other, not someone who hands off at the API boundary. Have deep, practical knowledge of JavaScript, TypeScript, React, and modern CSS - including state management and side-effect handling in large applications. Are solid on backend fundamentals: at least one backend language you know well, API design, relational data modelling, and enough instinct for query performance to spot the problem before production does. Prior Golang experience is not mandatory but you have to be willing to adopt it and become comfortable with it fast. Hold an extremely high bar for quality. You know what great looks like, you notice the details others miss, and you don't ship work you wouldn't put your name on. Have a knack for data-heavy product surfaces - performance, readability, and the principles behind a chart that actually communicates something. Care about the user's problem, not just the ticket. You start from what someone is trying to get done and work back to the implementation. Own outcomes, not output. You follow your work into production, watch how it behaves, and fix what needs fixing. Thrive in ambiguity and move fast. You make confident decisions with incomplete information, adapt when things change, and course-correct without drama. Are hands-on with AI tools. You actively use AI as a core part of how you build, not a side experiment, and you have opinions about where it helps and where it doesn't. Don't need to be managed. You set your own direction, keep people in the loop, and ask for help when it matters. Have excellent written and verbal English communication skills. You write clearly, explain technical tradeoffs to non-engineers without jargon, and default to async communication that others can follow. Are eager to contribute to the engineering team's growth - code review, mentoring, and interviewing included. Value transparency, ownership, and speed over perfection. You ship, learn, and improve rather than waiting for the perfect plan. Nice to have: Experience with TanStack is a bonus, and so is a real understanding of frontend caching and eventual consistency, we'd love to hire someone who's dealt with that tradeoff directly. Experience with capacity planning, scheduling, reporting, or other complex B2B SaaS products. Experience working with distributed or microservice systems, a basic understanding of infrastructure and infrastructure as code, and some experience creating, improving, or debugging CI/CD pipelines. This Role Is NOT A ticket-taker role. If you want fully specced work handed to you, this isn't the right fit. A pixel-pusher translating finished designs into code with no say in the problem or the solution. A role where you hand off at the API boundary. If "that's a backend ticket" is your instinct, this will frustrate you. A role where quality is someone else's job. Toggl doesn't have a dedicated QA team or layer: there's no separate team that will catch your bugs, write your tests, or own your performance regressions. A place to work in isolation from users. You'll be expected to know who you're building for and why. A role for people who need heavy process, frequent approvals, or top-down direction to do their best work. The Team We are a global team of ~80 awesome people working from over 40 countries around the globe. We hire globally, you work locally—in the heart of London, a beach outside of Río de Janeiro, or a quiet village near Florence, the choice is yours. Every few months we travel to meet up somewhere in the world and spend some quality time together. We place a huge amount of trust in our people, and we measure the outcomes rather than the work itself. Our values fuel our results. What's Happening at Toggl Toggl is at an exciting turning point. We're taking our best-in-class time tracking - trusted and loved by millions of users worldwide - and expanding it into something bigger: Toggl 2.0 . One product that brings together time tracking, planning, capacity management, reporting, and insight. The idea is simple: better time tracking creates better data, which powers everything else. We call it time intelligence. We build with AI throughout, and we think it's a real multiplier for strong engineers rather than a substitute for them. The judgment, the tradeoffs, and the accountability for what ships stay with people. Benefits Freedom to choose when and how much you work—we only measure results 24 days of paid time off a year, plus your local holidays Unlimited sick leave In-person meetups for team-building (expenses covered) 4-6 weeks paid sabbatical (depending on tenure) Laptop budget up to 2,500€ and it renews every 3 years €2,000 budget to set up your home office and an additional €300 every year after 3 years of tenure €3,000 per year for co-working space membership and/or internet service at home €4,000 per year contribution to use for training, workshops, and conferences €2,400 per year contribution for any equipment or services to improve and/or maintain your physical and mental health Support for buying tools you need for doing your best work (even eyeglasses if you need a new pair) To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/toggl-senior-full-stack

items.description: Sales and Marketing Headquarters: Remote, Texas, United States, AMER From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven. About Us Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data. Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on. Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions. As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact. During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites. About the Role The Enterprise Account Executive will drive towards aggressive new customer and partner revenue goals, while growing our footprint in the Enterprise market. This is a full-time, remote position and must be based out of Texas in the United States. Please note that the compensation listed below does not include commission (uncapped 50/50 split) or RSU value. What You'll Do Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, customer success, alliances, operations, and analytics to drive pipeline generation and exceed revenue goals. Accelerate the growth & adoption of Fivetran in the Enterprise Market through value-driven sales cycles. Lead in-depth discovery and demonstrate a deep interest in our Enterprise customers’ data challenges, identify required capabilities and positive business outcomes to drive towards valuable long term customer engagements. Speak comfortably about Fivetran’s vision to a broad range of audiences from C-level executives to individual contributors. Seek out and land deals with new Enterprise target accounts, then look to grow their footprint with Fivetran through new use cases, cross-sells and expansion. Build strategic relationships with partners in order to identify new opportunities and accelerate deal cycles. Forecast accurately and provide clear visibility on sales and revenue performance by actively managing and progressing opportunities. Skills We're Looking For 8+ years of large enterprise software sales experience and well-developed pattern recognition for navigating complex organizations. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to hold multiple stakeholders accountable throughout a complex value-driven sales cycle. In-depth familiarity with the modern data technology industry and key players. You are familiar with a solution-based approach to selling, have experience managing a complex sales process and possess excellent presentation and listening skills, organization and contact management capabilities. You thrive in an extremely fast-paced, ever changing work environment. You’re able to keep up with a highly motivated team in a market that is growing extremely fast. You are extremely organized. You are able to juggle lots of things at once while not letting anything drop. You are a strategic thinker. You are able to see and communicate the big picture in an inspiring way. You are a problem solver. You are resilient and creative, able to be resourceful to proactively seek out a solution to a problem. You are enthusiastic! You exhibit passion and excitement for your work and you have a can-do attitude. Previous experience with data integration, database, ETL, or business intelligence technologies is a plus, but not required Please note that the base + uncapped commission compensation listed below does not include RSU value. This position qualifies for Fivetran’s incentive plan, and it’s common for employees in this role to achieve the total on-target earnings. As part of our commitment to setting new hires up for success, all new sales team members attend a one-week, in-person Revenue Bootcamp during their second week at Fivetran. This bootcamp, held at one of our designated company locations, requires travel and is a mandatory part of the onboarding process. The compensation range displayed on this job posting reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire compensation for the target position and level, and may include sales incentives or target bonuses depending on the role. Our compensation ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Our job titles may span more than one career level. Within the range, individual compensation is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, relevant education or training, business need, market demands. The compensation range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. Your recruiter can share more about the specific compensation range for your location during the hiring process. Pay Range $151,351 — $189,189 USD OTE (On Target Earning) $302,702 — $378,378 USD Perks and Benefits 100% employer-paid medical insurance * Generous paid time away from work, including paid vacation or flexible/unlimited vacation depending on role and country, plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave, paid holidays, including a year-end Global Week of Rest, and volunteer days off. RSU stock grants* Professional development and training opportunities Company virtual happy hours, free food, and fun team-building activities Monthly cell phone stipend Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching, and self-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents. * May vary by country and worker type - please reach out to your recruiter for more information Click here to learn more about Fivetran's Benefits by Region. items.description: Who we are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the role: Samsara’s AI has helped prevent accidents that would have harmed an estimated 380,000 people per year. Every model we ship runs in the real world, on real roads, protecting real drivers. Every Samsara dash cam, gateway, and industrial sensor runs AI at the edge. These models detect distracted driving, prevent collisions, and keep workers safe, all in real time on constrained hardware. As Engineering Manager, you’ll own how AI moves from a trained model to firmware running reliably on devices in the field across Samsara’s customer fleet. You will drive Samsara’s edge AI strategy while mentoring engineers and delivering high-impact solutions. You will oversee the deployment of next-generation intelligent safety features and video processing by integrating high-performance camera systems and real-time edge computing into Samsara’s fleet and industrial products. In addition, you will establish the technical strategy, cross-functional relationships, and operational cadence required to launch low-latency, high-quality hardware programs at scale. This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role. Scale: Millions of AI dash cams, 100B+ miles/year (~99% of U.S. roads), 25T+ data points. You should apply if: You want to impact the industries that run our world: The software, firmware, and hardware you build will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. You are a life-long learner: We have ambitious goals. Every Samsarian has a growth mindset as we work with a wide range of technologies, challenges, and customers that push us to learn on the go. You believe customers are more than a number: Samsara engineers enjoy a rare closeness to the end user and you will have the opportunity to participate in customer interviews, collaborate with customer success and product managers, and use metrics to ensure our work is translating into better customer outcomes. You are a team player: Working on our Samsara Engineering teams requires a mix of independent effort and collaboration. Motivated by our mission, we’re all racing toward our connected operations vision, and we intend to win – together. In this role, you will: Lead a team of ~5 firmware and ML engineers. Your team builds, optimizes, and deploys AI models on Samsara’s fleet and industrial devices. Your work directly affects whether a driver gets a warning before a collision, not after. Provide hands-on technical leadership. Lead from the front technically, contributing directly to the design, implementation, and optimization of high-performance production systems. Set the technical bar for edge ML and embedded systems. You’ll guide architecture decisions on latency, power, memory, and model performance, and mentor engineers to go deep on problems most teams never touch. Turn new AI capabilities into shipped products. You’ll partner with Product, Hardware, and Full-stack teams to take features from concept to deployment on devices. You’ll also keep improving the ones customers rely on every day. Shape the roadmap. You’ll work with leadership on quarterly plans that balance product ambition with engineering health, and make the tradeoffs that deliver the most customer impact. Build a team people want to join and stay on. You’ll create a culture of ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement, with a high bar for execution quality and room for people to grow. Scale Samsara’s culture as we grow globally. You’ll champion and role model our principles as the team expands across new offices: Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, and Win as a Team. Hire and develop top talent. You’ll grow an inclusive, engaged, high-performing team, and help define what great edge AI engineering looks like at Samsara. Minimum requirements for the role: 3+ years of hands-on execution-oriented technical management experience. 8+ years of experience in embedded systems and edge machine learning development. Proven track record managing a team of engineers that has shipped a mass production product. Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work well in a diverse fast paced customer-focused environment. Experience deploying CV/ML models on edge devices in real-world applications. An ideal candidate also has: Experience working on products from concept to mass production. Proficiency in C/C++, Rust, or similar programming languages. Proficiency in gstreamer, Google MediaPipe, or similar edge AI/Media frameworks. Experience with data analysis using tools such as Databricks, SQL queries, Tableau. Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or equivalent field. The compensation range shown spans approved pay zones for this role. Your primary work location determines the range applicable to you, which may be narrower than the full range displayed. The range of annual base salary for full-time employees for this position is below. Please note that base pay offered may vary depending on factors including your city of residence, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role is also eligible for an initial RSU grant with no vesting cliff, and ongoing refresh opportunities tied to performance, subject to plan terms and conditions. Learn more about our total rewards and benefits below. Annual Base Salary $154,700—$260,000 USD Total Rewards At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time. Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here. Flexible Working At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable. Belonging at Samsara At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.
